name: RRSOS PCC Trash
description: A small trash can on the window of a storage container (Container1-3, fridge, vault, locker), one slot above the game's sort icon on the left of the grid. One click deletes everything in that container for good, with no question asked; the container stays. The same can sits on the personal inventory window (setting TrashOnPerson, on by default) and deletes only the backpack, never the equipment.
